source_changes.compression_lifetime: BinaryContext now owns the MCTargetOptions referenced by every MC context and carries the qualified split-input DebugCompressionType into temporary DWO streamers
source_changes.dwp_logical_contents: DWP contribution offsets are applied to stable decompressed section buffers instead of the raw SHF_COMPRESSED byte stream
source_changes.atomic_rejection: all unique split objects are checked for one supported compression algorithm before output-directory creation or worker emission; mixed algorithms publish neither the linked candidate nor a DWO
source_changes.regression: a new ARM lit case covers standalone zstd DWO, two-unit zstd DWP extraction and atomic mixed-algorithm rejection

mechanisms: the standalone compressed DWO resolved one CU but its rewritten sections were emitted uncompressed because the temporary MC streamer did not inherit the input algorithm
the compressed DWP candidate returned success from llvm-dwarfdump --verify, but a full --debug-info --dwo traversal resolved only one of two CUs and crashed on corrupt string/range contribution data
mixed zlib/zstd input rejected the linked candidate but left two partial DWO files, violating atomic publication
the first inventory parser missed combined CE/MSCE flag spellings; the corrected oracle distinguishes the compressed flag from the decoded compression algorithm

mixed_algorithm_control.diagnostic: mixed compression algorithms in split-DWARF input

scope_limits: the accepted compressed split cases use Clang DWARF5 with one standalone CU and one two-CU DWP; GCC-compressed split objects, DWARF4 DWP, type units, arbitrary package sizes and alternate compressor versions remain unqualified
FirmBOLT emits per-unit DWO files from DWP input; this milestone does not emit a replacement DWP package
MC compression is retained by algorithm for sections whose compressed representation is smaller; small rebuilt sections may lawfully remain uncompressed
llvm-dwarfdump --verify alone did not detect the pre-fix DWP corruption, so acceptance additionally requires full split-unit traversal and the exact expected CU count
the full suite establishes global non-regression for applicable tests on this host; 150 target-inapplicable tests remain skipped and 32 dependency or feature cases remain unsupported
the production and fixed-work gates are preservation and installation evidence, not complete x86-backend parity or a statistically powered speedup claim
patch-aware transformation semantics remain a later phase; this production gate uses the explicit empty patch contract
